title: SCA Tish'a BeAb 2022: Mrs. Rachelle Tawil

chapters.title: Waiting for Mashiach
chapters.about: Introduction to waiting for Mashiach and the questions people have about when he will arrive.

chapters.title: Expecting vs. Waiting
chapters.about: Analyzing the Gemara about judgment and the difference between passive waiting and active expectation.

chapters.title: The Rambam on the Days of Mashiach
chapters.about: Reviewing the Rambam's perspective on the times of Mashiach and what the world will look like.

chapters.title: Patience and Action
chapters.about: Discussing the balance of being patient and impatient, and personal reflections on patience.

chapters.title: Yitzchak and Rivka
chapters.about: Examining Yitzchak's prayer for Rivka in Parashat Toldot as an example of active prayer.

chapters.title: Yaakov and Rachel
chapters.about: Looking at Yaakov working for Rachel and how he gave purpose to the years of waiting.

chapters.title: Yosef in Jail
chapters.about: Exploring Yosef's actions in prison while waiting for Hashem's timing.

chapters.title: B'nei Yisrael in Mitzrayim
chapters.about: Discussing B'nei Yisrael crying out in Egypt and the Ramban's commentary on redemption.

summary: Mrs. Tawil explores the concept of waiting for Mashiach through the lens of active anticipation rather than passive expectation. She examines traditional sources and figures from the Torah like Yitzchak, Yaakov, Yosef, and B'nei Yisrael to illustrate how faith is combined with personal effort and prayer.
questions: What does it truly mean to wait for Mashiach?
How do we balance patience and action in our daily lives?
What can we learn from the ways biblical figures like Yitzchak, Yaakov, and Yosef waited?
Why is active anticipation considered essential in our relationship with Hashem?
